judge.why: The plan names two different companies. On P10, the Management Agreement says 'the Sponsor shall arrange for First Property Investment LLC, located at 141-18 Cherry Avenue, Flushing, NY 11354 to manage the building', and the same paragraph also names First Property Management LLC as a Sponsor affiliate. On P12, the Identity of Parties section says 'The Managing Agent is First Property Management LLC'. P11 says Mr. Yang is employed by 'First Property Investment, LLC'. Both names are printed as the managing agent, so I marked both accurate. For 'printed' I chose the Identity of Parties wording because it formally names the Managing Agent, but the pages don't settle the conflict.
